purpose: Pre-registers LLM DECISION LINEAGES for forward-test attribution -- the live analogue of candidate_registry.json (which registers mechanical strategies). A lineage is a per-symbol semantic family of decision configurations asserted to be the SAME edge hypothesis. Graduation is evaluated per (lineage x symbol). See docs/design/llm-decision-identity-attribution.md.
methodology: DEFAULT-MATERIAL: any config_hash not listed under a lineage's member_config_hashes is its own singleton lineage (unregistered:<hash8>::<SYMBOL>) and never inherits a registered lineage's forward record. Folding a hash into a lineage is an explicit, dated edit governed by that lineage's material_change_policy -- a material change (model major version, analyst add/remove, gate move, prompt-intent change) MUST start a new lineage with a zero forward record. Lineages must be pre-registered BEFORE their forward window is counted; all active lineages form one BH-FDR family (q=0.10).

graduation_rule.note: Per (lineage x symbol). Necessary, not sufficient, for live sizing -- gate-v2 routing still governs.

lineages.hypothesis: Dollar-neutral MES/M2K log-spread mean-reverts around its 40-bar z-score. Strongest relative-value pair found (data/spread_pairs_results.md): H1 genuinely profitable (PF 1.25) so it clears the chronological split ES-NQ failed, cost-robust to 4bp, edge mid-sample not just tail. Pre-registered with an EMPTY forward window; observe-only dark track confirms persistence on OOS time before any promotion.
lineages.material_change_policy: Any change to window/entry/exit/stop, the cost model, or the leg pair is a material change that MUST start a NEW lineage with a zero forward record.

lineages.hypothesis: Long equity-index beta across the turn-of-month window harvests a stationary calendar premium. SPY 1993-2026 Sharpe 1.07 gross / 0.79 net@2bps, positive in every 5yr era incl 2008/2020, stationary H1 1.23 / H2 1.20 (project_session_anomaly_tom_edge_2026_06_24). FAILs core gate-v2 only on p_edge<0.95 (mis-calibrated for low-freq long-beta harvest -> R2 beta-harvest variant). Pre-registered to satisfy paper_shadow_passed before any beta-harvest promotion.
lineages.material_change_policy: Any change to the turn-of-month window definition or the vehicle is a material change that MUST start a NEW lineage with a zero forward record.

lineages.hypothesis: Long equity-index beta on the session BEFORE a market holiday harvests a calendar premium. STANDOUT of the free-daily calendar discovery: robust across all 5 ETFs, SPY+GLD pass gate-v2 ALT (stronger than turn-of-month). SPY 1993-2026 over 302 pre-holiday days: mean 7.91 bps/day net@2bps, Sharpe 1.32 net, PF 1.28, maxDD 7.75% (computed 2026-06-25). Pre-holiday days are inferred gap-free from the trading index (no hardcoded calendar). Pre-registered with an EMPTY forward window to satisfy paper_shadow_passed before any promotion.
lineages.material_change_policy: Any change to the pre-holiday detection rule or the vehicle is a material change that MUST start a NEW lineage with a zero forward record.
